structured.feedback: The description is about 215 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it avoids the missing-lid complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, "Many customers" overstating a single green-tea review, and a warm-water tip that hints at the cap being hard to remove.
